recorded: 2026-11-08, after Stage 10 Phase 1 (decision CONTINUE: P 7 facts reached, B b 0.39 / forget-retain +0.34) and before any Phase 2A job was submitted. preregistration_stage10.json is unchanged; this file adds Phase 2A only.
status: [PROVISIONAL: single seed] -- seed 42, 40 facts about 2 entities, one unlearning re-run
question: Is the Japanese copy's survival a DELAY? Stage 8 / Phase 1 read Japanese at French TR 0.853 (step 26), where French is already at its never-taught level (removed 1.74). Job 19's own trajectory goes on: French TR 0.954 (step 28), 1.41 (32), 2.74 (36), 5.47 (40), 67.6 (46), 1441 (54), with MU_6 0.468 -> 0.381 (40) -> 0.378 (60). The copied-name protection (side checks) turned out to be a delay: pushed further, names fell too. Does the Japanese copy follow French down once French is pushed past never-taught, beyond the collateral that the French-only retain term leaves on ALL Japanese text?
seen_before_writing_this: Phase 1 (phase1.json): at tr0p783 the median Japanese share is 0.06; 7 of 26 eligible facts reached (4 20 25 30 33 34 38); the sample-lost facts are mostly different ones (22 26 20 30 24 0); span (gold fact-token) removal ~0. Job 19's French trajectory and MU (above). NO Japanese number exists past step 26, and no Japanese retain truth ratio exists at any checkpoint.

run.recipe: job 19 UNCHANGED (19_unlearn_frja.sbatch: gradient difference, Full-FT, forget01_fr + retain99_fr, floornone, 50 epochs = 100 steps on one linear LR schedule, French surname-normalized TR probe every 2 steps, MU every 20 and at every crossing), started from fr-ja_ft, under a NEW run tag srcfrja2 so nothing of job 19 is overwritten. Slurm: 26_unlearn_frja_deep.sbatch.
run.tr_levels_why: 0.6499 / 0.6943 / 0.7831 = job 19's levels, so the deleted tr0p650 / tr0p694 depth trend is restored and tr0p783 is re-made in this run (the in-run anchor and a training re-run replicate). The rest are first crossed in job 19 at steps ~28, 32, 36, 40, 46, 54 -- every 2-4 steps through the range where French goes from never-taught to collapse, out to about the copied-name side check's epoch 25. Training is not bit-reproducible, so levels are matched on French TR (the study's convention), not on step.
run.disk: up to 9 x 16.4 GB in experiments/tr_levels/ (levels crossed at the same probe point are symlinks).

measures.eligible: Phase 1's 26 eligible facts, frozen (eligible_facts below); atomic = those marked atomic in probes/fact_keys_frja.json (20).
measures.forget: Japanese question -> Japanese answer TR (TOFU Eq. 1, arithmetic, raw), per fact, mean over 3 scoring passes (gate_frja.py unchanged, groups storage_frja / storage_followup_rescore1 / _rescore2). dF_L = median over eligible facts of (TR_L - TR_ft).
measures.collateral: Japanese RETAIN TR: the same Eq. 1 on the 400 Japanese retain_perturbed rows (gold paraphrase vs 5 perturbed answers; 399 trained), one pass, at fr-ja_ft and every level (storage_followup.py part retain_tr). dR_L = median over rows of (TR_L - TR_ft). The French retain term does not protect these rows, so dR_L is the general Japanese damage in the forget measure's own unit.
measures.gap: G = median over eligible facts of (TR_floor - TR_ft), floor = fr-ja_retain, 3-pass means.
measures.s: forget-specific Japanese share s_L = (dF_L - dR_L) / G. 0 = Japanese forget moved no more than Japanese retain; 1 = moved the whole learned -> never-taught gap beyond it.
measures.usable: a level is USABLE when its MU_6 (from the run's trajectory row at the crossing) >= 0.3735, preregistration.json mu_threshold -- the study's existing 'model still usable' line (Stage 2 gate). Below it the level is reported as 'collapsed' and not read for the decision.
measures.beyond: levels BEYOND the primary: French TR level > 0.7831 (0.95 and up).

decision.DELAY: s_L >= 0.50 at some USABLE level beyond the primary. Reading: the Japanese copy lags French; pushed further it follows (as copied names did). Storage claim becomes 'at matched depth the Japanese copy survives; it is a delay, not a separate store'.
decision.SEPARATE: s_L < 0.25 at EVERY usable level beyond the primary, with at least 2 such levels. Reading: the Japanese copy survives French unlearning well past French's never-taught level, beyond the collateral -- the storage claim stands, stronger.
decision.PARTIAL: neither: some usable level beyond the primary has 0.25 <= s_L < 0.50, none >= 0.50. Reported with the per-level numbers; storage claim worded as 'partly follows'.
decision.INCONCLUSIVE: fewer than 2 usable levels beyond the primary and no DELAY (the model collapses too fast to tell).
decision.after: Phase 2A CLOSES storage whichever outcome: no Phase 2B. 0.25 / 0.50 are chosen bars (Phase 1's REACHED bar and its 'half way'), not derived.

secondary_not_decisive.per_fact: Phase 1's REACHED rule (3-pass non-overlap AND share >= 0.25) at every level: count, and whether Phase 1's 7 facts stay reached and the set grows.
secondary_not_decisive.replicate: this run's tr0p783 against job 19's tr0p783 (Phase 1): reached count and overlap with the 7, median share. Same seed, re-run training -- a replicate of training nondeterminism, not of seed.
secondary_not_decisive.behaviour: per level: sampled stated rate on Phase 1's atomic eligible facts and b (Phase 1 definition); Japanese greedy word-for-word forget vs retain relative drop (Phase 1's B second half).
secondary_not_decisive.french: per level: step, French TR (trajectory), French share (3-pass), MU_6.
secondary_not_decisive.depth_trend: levels 0.6499 / 0.6943 (lost from Phase 1) reported in the same tables.
